application_conditions: 'Open to all users': start from ether.fi/app/cash/affiliate (an ether.fi account is implied); no approval step described. Multiple referral links allowed.
paid_action: Qualifying referral = sign-up through the link + Cash card activation + $100 or more of personal spending ('Sign-up alone does not qualify'). Card activation and spend are the paid actions, which fits a card comparator.
validation_conditions: Referral must activate the Cash card and reach $100+ personal spend. Tier upgrades require both all-time and rolling-90-day referral counts (Tier 2: 50 / 10; Tier 3: 100 / 20; Tier 4: 500 / 50), reviewed monthly.

commission.model_note: Tiered hybrid: new-member bonus $10 / $15 / $20 / $20 and high-spender bonus $15 / $20 / $25 / $25 per qualifying referral (Tier 1–4); 0.1–0.3% cashback on referral spending; 20–25% physical-card commission; 50% card-fee commission; 5–12.5% Liquid and staked yield revenue share; 20% second-degree revenue share from Tier 2.
commission.tiers_note: Tier 1 figures recorded as the base (amount = new-member bonus). Page's '$867,000' figure is a projection for 500 referrals/month, stated as an estimate.

revenue_share.included_products: Card fees (50%), physical cards (20–25%), referral spending cashback (0.1–0.3%), Liquid and staked yield (5–12.5%).

payout.method: USDC 'directly into your Vault with Cash'

rules_note: Page links the general Terms of Use (etherfi.gitbook.io) and says 'Additional program rules may apply'; no affiliate-specific agreement found. 'Products may not be available in all jurisdictions.' Payout requires an ether.fi Vault/Cash account (on-chain USDC), which is a payout-destination decision for David.

evidence.title: ether.fi Affiliate Program (official page)

notes: Programme pays on card activation and spend — relevant to the comparator. Terms not fully documented (general Terms of Use only). No application made; payout in USDC to an on-chain Vault needs David's decision.
